Strategy: Scaled dual-ratio band avoidance. Exact fits score highest; residuals whose ratio to the item rounds to one or two lose a penalty of half the item, while other residuals rank like Best Fit. The choice differs from Best Fit when the tightest fit leaves a residual near one or two item sizes while a looser bin avoids both bands. It may help by scaling the deterrent with item size, but may fail if the penalty proves too small.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [1000.0 if r - item == 0 else (-(r - item) - item / 2 if round((r - item) / item) == 1 or round((r - item) / item) == 2 else -(r - item)) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Scaled dual-ratio band avoidance: penalize round(rem/item) in {1,2} by item/2, exact fit highest.
